newsitem.title: UK: Northern loses appeal in bid war with CE Electric.
newsitem.headline: Northern loses appeal in bid war with CE Electric.

text.p: Britain's takeover panel said on Monday that it had rejected an appeal by Northern Electric against an extension of the deadline for a hostile takeover bid by CE Electric of the United States.
The panel last week extended the deadline for CE's 782 million stg ($1.3 billion) bid for the British electric utility from Friday, December 20 until 1300 GMT on Tuesday December 24.
Northern had appealed against the panel's ruling, made because of a discrepancy over a fee paid to one of Northern Electric's advisers, BZW, which bought Northern shares in the market last week.
BZW failed to disclose until last Friday the 250,000 stg payment from Northern for its services in addition to its 1.5 million stg fixed fee. Northern appealed the decision.
"The Appeal Committee heard the appeal on 23 December and unaminously dismissed it," the panel said in a statement.
CE Electric, a unit of CalEnergy Co Inc, had by Monday boosted shareholder acceptances for its bid to just over the 50 percent needed for victory from 49.77 percent on Friday.
